I played a ton in Seasons 1 and 2 then took a long break up until the middle of this season. I've actually found the community to be surprisingly tamer and generally more accepting of non-meta picks.

Sure, there were those early days of Season 1 where you literally could take any champion anywhere (except jungle) and people were cool with it but as the game evolved into the 1-1-2 lane + jungle meta by Season 2, the toxicity of the community was not only brutal but personal as well. You're always going to get opinionated players who think there is one "right" way of playing league and that in a perfectly static universe where all else is equal, they will always win because they do the "right" things and are god players.

On the flip side, playing this game well and enjoying it means being a team player yourself and figuring out what direction your teammates want to take the team. If your support autolocks Blitz, he obviously wants a hard engage kill lane. So if you end up taking an ADC that's poke/farm early game instead of kill, it's at least half (probably more since you picked after him) your fault that the lane had no synergy.
